name: Olivia Harrison
bio:
Olivia discovered her passion for motorsport while attending the Indy 500 with her family as a child. Captivated by the roar of the engines and the electric atmosphere, she knew she wanted to be involved in the racing world. After graduating with a degree in Marketing from Indiana University, she sought opportunities to combine her skills with her love for motorsport, eventually landing a role with Reiza Racing Academy.

As a marketing coordinator, Olivia focuses on building the Reiza Racing Academy brand through innovative campaigns and strategic partnerships. She's known for her meticulous approach and unwavering dedication to achieving exceptional results. Olivia believes in crafting compelling narratives that resonate with fans and sponsors alike, ensuring Reiza Racing Academy remains at the forefront of the motorsport scene. Her drive for perfection and keen eye for detail are her defining strengths.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy, often pulled back in a high ponytail during intense work sessions.
physical.description: Olivia is petite with a focused, intense gaze.

quirks: Always has a meticulously organized color-coded planner.
Insists on using specific motorsport jargon even in casual conversations.
Has a lucky charm that she keeps on her desk during race weekends - a miniature checkered flag.
